sentences.text:
(Per the Hon'ble the Chief Justice Alok Aradhe) Ms. B. Rachana Reddy, learned Senior Counsel for the petitioners.
Mr. M.S. Achyuth Bharthwaj, learned counsel for the impleaded petitioners in W.P.No.37769 of 2017.
Mr. A. Sanjeev Kumar, learned Special Government Pleader attached to the office of learned Additional Advocate General for the respondents.
2.

In this bunch of writ petitions, the petitioners are the owners of various parcels of agricultural lands situated at Allipur village of Siddipet District, Sirikonda village of Rajanna Sircilla District,
Mamidyala village of Siddipet District and Kochaguttapally village of Siddipet District.
The petitioners sometime between June and August, 2016 have entered into agreements with the respondents for receipt of compensation in respect of their agricultural lands.
3. The grievance in these writ petitions is with regard to non-payment of just and fair compensation and in not extending the Rehabilitation and Resettlement benefits to the petitioners.

4. Learned counsel for the parties jointly submitted that the issue involved in these petitions is squarely covered by a common order dated 04.09.2023 passed by this Court in W.P.Nos.3420, 9146 and 25664 of 2019 and 2188 of 2020.

5. In view of the aforesaid submission and for the reasons assigned by us in the aforesaid common order dated 04.09.2023, these writ petitions are also disposed of with the following directions:
(i) It will be open to the petitioners to file documents in support of their claim before the Revenue Divisional Officer, Siddipet and ::3::

1 Rajanna Sircilla, within a period of one (1) week from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.

sentences.text: (ii) Thereupon, the Revenue Divisional Officer, Siddipet and Rajanna Sircilla, shall consider the claims of the petitioners within a period of two (2) months from today by a speaking order.

(iii) Needless to state that the amount due to the petitioners shall be paid within a further period of two (2) weeks of determination of their entitlement along with interest as per the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
